patches.value: First treat L1: n=0. N002 gives E=Eucl(0), a singleton, and D=0. The map from I to F sending t to the concatenated point ((),t) is onto and preserves all distances by the Euclidean formula. N003 gives H^a(I)=0 for every a>1. For any positive scale and cost tolerance, choose a cover of I at that scale with cost below the tolerance, intersect each cover member with I, and send it through this map. These sets cover F and have no larger diameters or costs. Thus H^a(F)=0 for every a>1. By N001, dim_H(F)<=a for every a>1, hence dim_H(F)<=1=D+1. Discharge L1 and retain this branch conclusion.

patches.new: By N001, dim_H(F)<=q+1. Since q>D was arbitrary, universally quantify q in this conclusion.

value.statement: Under n>=1, for every real q_b>D, H^(q_b+1)(F)=0 and dim_H(F)<=q_b+1.
